guidance: And on the raw material security side, work continues on our captive iron ore blocks in Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh, with FY28 remaining our internal target for these to become operational.

capex: As I had mentioned on our last call, FY26 was a year of consolidation for us and FY27 was always meant to be the year in which our expansion begins to show up in the numbers.
